family_inheritance.rule: Every child inherits the family DNA from its parent authority and overrides only its task, data, modules, actions and states. SHARED DESIGN ≠ SHARED LOGIC.
never_inherit: LEGACY AIO VISUALS (header, nav geometry, sidebar, footer, page width, grid, card system, panel system, typography, spacing, color, responsive rules, layout, composition, visual proportion, shell architecture)

FOUNDER_STAFF.actor_override: LIGHT_PRIMARY + DARK_OPERATIONAL_ACCENTS, denser; OVERVIEW replaces PROGRESS; CLIENT HEALTH + tasks + team activity + risks

PUBLIC.actor_override: DARK_PRIMARY cinematic; sections instead of tabs; SAMPLE data only

family_inheritance.child_proof_rule: FUEL PURCHASES proves the derivation; it is not a template copied into every tab.
